content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD time-integration right-hand-side and velocity recovery (BSD header L1-44). Two subroutines. (1) ESTIMATE_HUV(ISTEP) (L53-351): one stage of the 3rd-order Runge-Kutta (LK scheme per header L46-47, 'MUSCL-Hancock, Zhou et al., p. 7' L80). Optional modules VESSEL/SUBGRID/SEDIMENT/PRECIPITATION (L55-66). First computes cell-center fluxes P_center=(P(I+1,J)+P(I,J))/2, Q_center, and depth-averaged U_davg=P_center/max(H,MinDepthFrc), V_davg for radiation stress (L94-101). Mass equation (L104-280): flux divergence R1=-1/DXg*(F_right-F_left)-1/DYg*(F_top-F_bottom) using face normals n_left=-1,n_right=1,n_bottom=-1,n_top=1 (parameter L70) with F=P,Q faces (L106-109); for wavemaker families WK_IRR/TMA_1D/JON_1D/JON_2D/WK_NEW_IRR/WK_NEW_DATA2D (Salatin et al. 2021 comments L113-114), WK_REG, WK_TIME, WK_DATA2D the source WaveMaker_Mass(I,J) is added inside the wavemaker box |xmk-Xc_WK|<Width_WK, |ymk-Yc_WK|<Ywidth_WK/2 (L126-146, L159-169, L182-191, L205-214), where xmk,ymk use iista/jjsta global offsets in PARALLEL (ykchoi Jan/23/2018, L119-120 and repeats) — old WK_Source Fourier-sum code is commented out (L131-136) since WaveMaker_Mass moved to sources.F 02/27/2017 (L129); the no-wavemaker ELSE (comment about a version 1.1 DXg/DYg bug L216-217) uses DXg scalar in CARTESIAN (L219-220, plus VESSEL VesselFluxGradient L221-223) and DX(I,J),DY(I,J) otherwise (L227-228); non-CARTESIAN adds spherical convergence term 1/R_earth*tan(Lat_theta)*HV (L241) or ZALPHA variant with (HV+Depth*V4*Gamma1) (L237-238). Wsurf=R1 records O(mu^2) surface vertical velocity (fyshi 07/07/2022, L246-247). SUBGRID divides by Porosity with zero-check warning (L250-254); SEDIMENT adds MassSed if SedimentMassSource (L258-260); PRECIPITATION adds PrecRateModel (L264). Eta update Eta=ALPHA(ISTEP)*Eta0+BETA(ISTEP)*(Eta+DT*R1) (L270; ITERATION variant with EtaOld L268), then ETA_LIMITER clips Eta to [TroughLimit,CrestLimit] (L272-276). Momentum: R2 from Fx,Fy faces + SourceX (L285-296), SEDIMENT DcX/ExgX additions (L299-304), Ubar=ALPHA*Ubar0+BETA*(Ubar+DT*R2) (L310, ITERATION variant L308); R3 from Gx,Gy + SourceY (L318-329), DcY/ExgY (L332-337), Vbar update (L343/L341). Finally CALL GET_Eta_U_V_HU_HV (L348). (2) GET_Eta_U_V_HU_HV (L365-604): recovers U,V from Ubar,Vbar. H=Eta*Gamma3+Depth (L373); SUBGRID replaces H by DepAvgSubgrid where MaskSubgrid==1 after UPDATE_SUBGRID (L377-385). If DISPERSION (L398): x-direction tridiagonal system per row — coefficients tmp1,tmp3 (off-diagonal) = Gamma1*MASK9*(b1/2/DX^2*dep^2 + b2/DX^2*depl*dep) etc., tmp2 diagonal = 1+Gamma1*MASK9*(-b1/DX^2*dep^2-2*b2/DX^2*dep^2), tmp4 RHS = Ubar*MASK/max(H,MinDepthFrc) + Gamma1*MASK9*(-b1/2*dep^2*Vxy - b2*dep*DVxy) (CARTESIAN L407-411; non-CARTESIAN L413-418) with dep,depl,depr floored depths (L402-404); COUPLING nesting moves known boundary U into RHS (L424-434); LEFT_BC_IRR wavemaker does the same at Ibeg (L436-449); normalized myA,myC,myD=tmpX/tmp2 guarded by tmp2/=0 .OR. MASK>0 (L452-460); solved by TRIDx (PARALLEL) or TRIDx_ser (L465-469), result into U. y-direction analog (L478-539): with CARTESIAN and DISP_TIME_LEFT the coefficients get Gamma2 nonlinear eta terms using reta,retal,retar (L485-500), else Gamma1-only forms (L502-506 CARTESIAN, L509-514 non-CARTESIAN); COUPLING south/north RHS moves (L517-527); PERIODIC y uses TRIDy_periodic (Sherman-Morrison, fyshi 01/27/2016, L541-546), else TRIDy/TRIDy_ser (L548-554), result into V. If no DISPERSION, U=Ubar/max(H,MinDepthFrc), V likewise (L559-564). Final masking/Froude-cap loop (L568-593): dry cells zero Ubar,Vbar,U,V,HU,HV (L570-576); wet cells HU=max(H,MinDepthFrc)*U, HV likewise (L578-579), and if Utotal/Fr>FroudeCap with Fr=sqrt(GRAV*max(H,MinDepthFrc)) the velocity is rescaled to FroudeCap*Fr along Utheta=atan2(V,U) (L581-589). ykchoi 07/26/2016 block (L595-602): when .NOT.DISPERSION, Ubar=HU and Vbar=HV.

verbatim_spans.text: ELSE ! no wk_wavemaker, theres bug in version 1.1 Dxg,Dyg should be
! evaluate vertical velocity at surface O(mu^2), fyshi 07/07/2022
! eta_limiter is used for the case as wave touches the seabed within wavemaker
! ykchoi : U0, V0 are moved to the above part of "Do istage=1,3"

unresolved: COUPLING y-direction boundary block tests IN_DOMAIN_SOUTH twice (IF @L518 and ELSEIF @L522) — the second should presumably be IN_DOMAIN_NORTH to mirror the x-direction WEST/EAST pair (L425-429); as written the Jend/north RHS move (L523-525) is unreachable

Guard condition IF(tmp2.NE.0.0_SP.OR.MASK(I,J).GT.0) (L452,L529) uses .OR., so a masked cell with tmp2/=0 still forms coefficients and a zero tmp2 with MASK>0 still divides by tmp2 — whether .AND. was intended is not decidable here

The non-wavemaker CARTESIAN R1 branch uses scalar DXg,DYg (L219-220) while the comment L216-217 says version 1.1 had a bug where Dxg,Dyg should be DX() and DY() — the non-CARTESIAN fix is at L227-228, but all wavemaker R1 branches (L138-145 etc.) still use scalar DXg,DYg regardless of CARTESIAN
WK_Source and kf,kd (declared L71,L78) are only used in commented-out code (L131-136); IM (L370) is declared but never used
ALPHA(ISTEP),BETA(ISTEP) RK coefficients, b1,b2,Gamma1,Gamma2,Gamma3,FroudeCap,TroughLimit,CrestLimit,WaveMaker_Mass,SourceX,SourceY and the TRID* solvers are defined in other files

In ESTIMATE_HUV the eta equation adds WaveMaker_Mass only inside the box test repeated per wavemaker type with identical R1 expressions (L126-214) — WK_DATA2D branch box test at L205-206 has a trailing '!' after THEN
Wsurf is assigned R1 before the SUBGRID porosity division and SEDIMENT/PRECIPITATION additions (L247 vs L249-265), so Wsurf excludes those mass sources
